analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + MACD histogram improving
analysis.reason: RSI 42.5에서 62.0으로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 -0.3873에서 1.0932로 개선되며 상승 추세 강화. 5일 저가 대비 현재가 회복하며 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 3거래일 연속 상승 추세 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 42.5 to 62.0, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -0.3873 to 1.0932, strengthening the uptrend. A Higher Low pattern formed as the price recovered from the 5-day low. The uptrend has been maintained for 3 consecutive sessions.

analysis.narrativeEn:

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): 1x target allocation filled, considering leverage for the next move.
